note: The Under the hood chapter of the long walkthrough (Tys, 29 Oct: the demo 'is like a black box at the moment'): one line a panel of cards/underhood.html, built from the None underwater job ce8fe479. Numbers are that job's own.

lines.text: Under the hood. First the song: it is split into stems with Demucs, and every beat and the drop are found in the mix. This track: seventy beats in thirty seconds, the drop at thirteen point seven.
Then the plan: a shot on every bar, a half bar on the drop. Here that is twenty-two shots, and the stems decide the effects on each: a punch on the downbeat, a stutter on the kick.
Then the chain: twenty-three stills, one object leading to the next. Twelve came from the None library, three were drawn first for the line: a seashell, coral, a pearl oyster.

Each shot is one morph: the still it starts on, the still it ends on, and a prompt that names them both and asks for the change across the whole clip. That graph goes to ComfyUI through the Comfy SDK, and LTX-2.5 renders it.
lines.say: Each shot is one morph: the still it starts on, the still it ends on, and a prompt that names them both and asks for the change across the whole clip. That graph goes to ComfyUI through the Comfy SDK, and LTX 2.5 renders it.

lines.text: The morph comes back as a short clip. Xenoform re-times it so the change lands on the beat, runs the effects the knobs asked for on the stems, and cuts it all to the song.
Every step leaves a file in the job folder: the beats, the plan, the chain, every morph. Nothing in it is a black box.
